decisions.reason: It has a strong reference result, is tightly linked to the core aviation-security offer, and after another year on the market management is even less likely to reverse a visibly backed product.
The system fits the firm's stated move toward higher-value integrated security solutions, and an expanding firm can justify slower uptake as temporary while continuing to support it.

Although still the weakest of the remaining products in visible market traction, it remains connected to the firm's aviation-security direction and prior commitment makes management more likely to persist than exit.
Its dedicated webpage, close fit with existing travel and document security services, and accumulated development investment all make withdrawal relatively unlikely.
